blocks.text: Machine learning uses different tools to collect, process and analyse data and to build models. Some are simple and beginner-friendly; others support advanced work. Each has its own strengths, and choosing the right tool improves efficiency and accuracy.

blocks.caption: Common tools
rows: Basic data analysis in rows and columns
Sorting, filtering, charts and simple formulas; easy to learn; good for small datasets and for beginners
A programming language for data analysis, widely used in research
Strong graphics for visualising data; handles large datasets; many packages for data science
A popular programming language for machine learning
Libraries such as pandas and NumPy; Jupyter shows code and results together in an interactive notebook; supports advanced machine learning and is widely used in industry
